accepted.quote: The reforms in H.R. 5262 would likely accelerate consolidation trends for smaller banks and would do nothing to fix a broken merger review process that has allowed megabanks to consolidate market power while ripping off consumers for years.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes waiving competition review and warns of consolidation, indicating support for strong bank merger regulation.
